Chief Fish Breeder: Elena Aleksandrovna Khanenko  
Elena Aleksandrovna Khanenko is a highly qualified fish breeder with more than 10 years of 
experience. Over the past ten years, Elena Alexandrovna has held the position of Chief Fish 
Breeder at Promrybtorg and Trout Paradise.
translated_text: Елена Александровна Ханенко - высококвалифицированный рыбовод с более чем 10-летним опытом.
